package.name: g1_ar_bridge
package.description: Snap Spectacles AR bridge (AGENTS.md §27): aligns the glasses with the RTAB-Map map through one AprilTag seen by a robot camera and by the glasses, then streams the robot pose, the LiDAR map, the Nav2 path and POIs / 3D boxes to the Dimensional OS Lens (protocol v19, WebSocket :8787), and publishes the glasses' pose on /tf. Read-only towards the robot: navigation goals and e-stop requests from the glasses are refused.
